fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: The teenage and young adult years bring plenty of change, including new independence, busy schedules, sport, study, work and social lives. These years also bring particular challenges for oral health. Preventive care helps young people build habits that support healthy teeth and gums well into adulthood.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: At Precision Dental, we speak with young adults respectfully and directly, giving them the information they need to make good decisions about their own health.

sections.label: What Is Preventive Care for Young Adults?

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Is Preventive Care for Young Adults?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Preventive care for young adults includes regular check-ups and cleans, early detection of decay, monitoring of developing wisdom teeth, and advice on the lifestyle factors that commonly affect oral health at this age. It also includes protective measures such as fluoride treatments, fissure sealants where appropriate and custom mouthguards for sport.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Is Preventive Care Right for You?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Preventive care is valuable for teenagers and young adults, especially those who:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Are becoming responsible for their own dental routine

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Play contact or ball sports

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Regularly drink soft drinks, energy drinks or sports drinks

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have, or are considering, oral piercings

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Smoke or vape

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have wisdom teeth that are developing or causing discomfort

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Are thinking about straightening or whitening their teeth

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Eligible teenagers may also be able to access benefits under the Child Dental Benefits Schedule.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Happens at Your Appointment

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Examination and Imaging

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We examine the teeth, gums and soft tissues and check the bite. Where appropriate, a digital OPG allows us to assess the position and development of wisdom teeth.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Professional Clean

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Plaque and tartar are removed, and teeth are polished. Fluoride may be applied to strengthen enamel, particularly for those at higher risk of decay.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Honest Conversation

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We talk openly about common risks for this age group. Sugary and acidic drinks can erode enamel and increase decay. Oral piercings can chip teeth and damage gums. Smoking and vaping can affect gum health and stain teeth. Where concerns exist, we also discuss the effects of frequent vomiting on tooth enamel in a caring, confidential way and can recommend appropriate support.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Looking Ahead

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If you are interested in Invisalign or teeth whitening, we can discuss whether these are suitable once your oral health is in good shape.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Aftercare and Ongoing Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste and clean between your teeth each day. Choose water over soft drinks and energy drinks, and wear a custom mouthguard for all contact training and games. If you have a piercing, check it regularly and consider removing it during sport. Keep up regular check-ups, especially while wisdom teeth are developing.

sections.label: Why Choose Precision Dental for Young Adult Care

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Choose Precision Dental for Young Adult Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our team creates a relaxed, respectful environment where young people feel comfortable asking questions. We use digital imaging to monitor development, provide practical advice without lecturing, and support families with clear communication.

sections.label: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we talk you through your options and the expected fees before any treatment begins. We accept most major health funds, process claims on the spot through HICAPS and are a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Payment plans are available through DentiCare for eligible patients, subject to terms and conditions. You can learn more on our Prices and Payment Options page.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: When should wisdom teeth be checked?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Wisdom teeth are often assessed in the mid to late teens using a digital OPG. This helps us monitor their development and position.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Are energy drinks bad for teeth?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Many energy and sports drinks are both acidic and high in sugar, which can erode enamel and increase the risk of decay. Water is the best choice.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can oral piercings damage teeth?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. Tongue and lip piercings can chip or crack teeth, wear enamel and contribute to gum recession. Regular dental reviews help identify early damage.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Does vaping affect oral health?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Vaping may contribute to dry mouth, gum irritation and other oral health concerns. We are happy to discuss this confidentially.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can teenagers have Invisalign?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Many teenagers are suitable for clear aligner treatment. We assess suitability at a consultation and explain the commitment involved.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can a teenager attend without a parent?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Depending on their age and maturity, some young people may attend independently. Please contact us to discuss consent requirements.
